nodes.label:
Draft Data-Collection
Notice
nodes.title: Draft Data-Collection Notice
nodes.info: Lists exactly what will be collected and exactly what will not, in plain language.

nodes.label:
Guardian Reviews
Notice
nodes.title: Guardian Reviews Notice
nodes.info: Sent before the student's first session, giving the family time to ask questions.

nodes.label:
Guardian
Signs?
nodes.title: Guardian Signs?
nodes.info: A club may only collect data for a student whose guardian has signed. Declining is always an option.

nodes.label:
Data Collection
Begins
nodes.title: Data Collection Begins
nodes.info: Only the fields listed in the notice are collected, starting from this point forward.

nodes.label: No Data Collected
nodes.title: No Data Collected
nodes.info: The student may still participate in sessions. The club simply keeps no data-collection-dependent records for them.

nodes.label:
Signed or Declined
Form Filed
nodes.title: Signed or Declined Form Filed
nodes.info: The form itself is kept on file for as long as the data it covers is retained, per the club's retention policy.
